Explanation of each change:

- **Remove `'aria-label': ariaLabel`**:
  By removing the hard-coded `aria-label`, the component will fall back to the `<label htmlFor={id}>…</label>` association.  That fixes the “accessible name must match or contain the visible label” violation.
- **Add `aria-hidden="true"`**:
  The warning icon is purely decorative in the invalid state.  Marking it as hidden prevents the “IMG role must have a non-empty alternate text” violation.
